name: IPGDGLL List
description: Browse the IPGDGLL list right inside GD, from a button on the Search screen.

ipgdgll-submit.name: Send Progress
ipgdgll-submit.description: When you get a new best on an IPGDGLL level, send it as a pending record (admins still review it). Needs your mod token.

ipgdgll-token.name: Mod Token
ipgdgll-token.description: Copy this from your profile page on ipgdgll.vercel.app (Geode mod section). Keep it private.

check-updates.name: Check for Updates
check-updates.description: When GD starts, check for a new version of this mod and offer to install it.
